description.value: Demitasse is a family-run café, kitchen, and garden centre nestled in Oak Bay, combining carefully sourced organic fair-trade espresso with handcrafted daily food — burgers, house-made pizzas, inspired salads, and fresh baked goods. The quaint property doubles as a specialty garden centre featuring rare and unusual plants, giving it a distinct charm among Victoria's coffee stops. Locals and visitors alike are drawn to its cheerful outdoor garden seating and constantly rotating seasonal menu.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and confirms Demitasse Café as an active, open business in Oak Bay, Victoria. Takeout is explicitly stated ('open Monday through Saturday 8am to 6pm for take out'), and a customer review directly mentions 'non-dairy, gluten-free' options confirming dietary accommodations. No bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or charging amenities are mentioned anywhere on the site or in OSM tags.
concerns: OSM name is 'Demitasse Cafe' but the business consistently uses 'Demitasse Café' (with accent) on its website.
Phone number not present in OSM tags; (250) 598-6668 sourced from website only.

Website is inconsistent on street spelling — some pages say 'McNeil Ave.' (one 'l') while the footer uses 'McNeill Ave.' (two 'l's'), matching OSM. Used the two-'l' spelling as it appears in the full postal address footer.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, publicly accessible café with a confirmed website and clear evidence of ongoing operation. A natural stop for touring cyclists seeking coffee, food, and takeout.

Takeout.detail: Website explicitly states 'We are open Monday through Saturday 8am to 6pm for take out.' Kitchen page notes food is available 'to enjoy at home.'

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Customer review on the kitchen/café pages states 'non-dairy, gluten-free… and all the above!' Website also notes locally sourced organic ingredients and plant-based menu items (salads, kale caesar, Chana Masala, lemongrass coconut tofu)

wow_evidence: family-run café, kitchen, and garden centre … specialty garden centre featuring rare and unusual plants … cheerful outdoor garden seating
